---
description: Enable caveman communication mode (lite/full/ultra/wenyan) for token-efficient responses. Use when invoking /caveman.
---

Activate caveman mode now.

If the user included a level after `/caveman`, set that level.
Valid levels: `lite`, `full`, `ultra`, `wenyan-lite`, `wenyan-full`, `wenyan-ultra`.

Behavior rules are defined in `.github/skills/caveman/SKILL.md` and must persist until the user says `stop caveman` or `normal mode`.
